name: Confidentiality Clause
description: Agreement must contain an explicit confidentiality or non-disclosure obligation.
requirement: Agreement must include explicit provisions protecting confidential and proprietary information.
remediation: Incorporate a standard confidentiality clause specifying obligations and exclusions.
recommendation: Incorporate a standard confidentiality clause specifying obligations and exclusions.

name: Agreement Duration & Term
description: Agreement must explicitly state its effective duration or term.
requirement: Agreement must define a valid start date, duration, or term length.

evaluation.semantic_query: agreement term duration validity period effective date

remediation: Define clear start and end dates or termination triggers for the agreement term.
recommendation: Define clear start and end dates or termination triggers for the agreement term.

name: Termination Conditions
description: Clear conditions for agreement termination with notice periods must exist.
requirement: Agreement must detail termination procedures, notice periods, and cause criteria.

evaluation.semantic_query: termination notice period written notice breach of contract agreement termination

remediation: Add a termination clause detailing written notice requirements and cure periods.
recommendation: Add a termination clause detailing written notice requirements and cure periods.

name: Data Protection & Privacy
description: Compliance with applicable data protection regulations (e.g. GDPR, CCPA).
requirement: Document must mandate personal data protection, privacy compliance, and handling guidelines.

evaluation.semantic_query: data protection privacy gdpr personal data processing compliance

remediation: Insert a comprehensive data processing and privacy protection schedule.
recommendation: Insert a comprehensive data processing and privacy protection schedule.

name: Governing Law & Jurisdiction
description: Specified legal jurisdiction and governing law clause.
requirement: Legal jurisdiction and applicable governing law must be stated.

evaluation.semantic_query: governing law jurisdiction legal court jurisdiction state law

remediation: Specify the applicable state/national law and primary court jurisdiction.
recommendation: Specify the applicable state/national law and primary court jurisdiction.

name: Dispute Resolution
description: Framework for resolving disputes (arbitration, mediation, or litigation).
requirement: Dispute resolution mechanisms (mediation/arbitration) must be defined.

evaluation.semantic_query: dispute resolution binding arbitration mediation litigation process

remediation: Define a step-by-step dispute escalation and arbitration mechanism.
recommendation: Define a step-by-step dispute escalation and arbitration mechanism.

name: Party Identification
description: Full legal names and addresses of all contracting parties.
requirement: All legal contracting parties must be explicitly identified.

evaluation.semantic_query: agreement entered into by and between parties legal entities

remediation: Include legal names, registered addresses, and corporate identifiers for all parties.
recommendation: Include legal names, registered addresses, and corporate identifiers for all parties.

name: Effective Date Identification
description: Explicit statement of the agreement's execution date.
requirement: Agreement must state an explicit effective date or date of execution.

evaluation.semantic_query: effective date dated as of execution date agreement start

remediation: State the exact effective date on page 1 of the document.
recommendation: State the exact effective date on page 1 of the document.

name: Confidential Information Definition
description: Detailed definition of what constitutes confidential information.
requirement: Scope and exclusions of confidential information must be clearly defined.

evaluation.semantic_query: confidential information scope definition includes technical financial trade secrets

remediation: Provide an explicit list of covered technical, financial, and operational information types.
recommendation: Provide an explicit list of covered technical, financial, and operational information types.

name: Data Retention Requirement
description: Policy specifying retention periods for business records and logs.
requirement: Data retention schedules must define explicit maximum storage periods (e.g. max 10 years).

evaluation.semantic_query: data retention period retain records storage schedule archive years

remediation: Define data retention schedules according to regulatory guidelines.
recommendation: Define data retention schedules according to regulatory guidelines.
